facts.business: Prima Industries Limited specializes in solvent extraction, edible oil refining, and cattle feed manufacturing, offering products such as compounded cattle feed, solvent-extracted coconut crude oil, de-oiled coconut cake, and refinery by-products.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Future plans to revamp refinery wing and venture into industrial warehousing and poultry feed manufacturing
guidance_or_targets.value: Revamp refinery, industrial warehousing, poultry feed

auditor.name: M/s. G. Joseph & Associates, Chartered Accountants

facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions with Prima Agro Limited, Ayyappa Roller Flour Mills Limited, and Prima Beverage Private Limited (entities in which Directors/Promoters are interested) for FY 2025-26 and proposed for FY 2026-27.
